actor: unchanged shared recurrent16 architecture and initialization semantics; trained independently per method
checkpoint_selection: final fixed-budget weights, no selection from validation or test

primary_contrast.estimand: mean paired difference of per-trained-seed mean physical sensor coverage over the100 fixed held-out scenarios

interval: pointwise95% percentile bootstrap resampling paired trained seeds after averaging100 episodes; conditional on this fixed test manifest; secondary contrasts descriptive and unadjusted
replication_unit: independent trained seed, paired across methods; never treat100 episodes as100 training replications
failure_policy: Keep every planned outcome; no seed replacement, test-driven retuning, budget extension or outcome-driven checkpoint choice. Failed/incomplete tests remain ledger entries and make the full-sample comparison incomplete; no silent dropping or invented outcomes. A separately logged mechanical checkpoint recovery must preserve the locked budget and charge prior work.
entropy_policy: Entropy is a diagnostic, never a criterion for removing a poor or deterministic trained policy from final evaluation; finite updates and gradient connections remain correctness gates.

budget_rationale.choice: Preserve all8 independent trained seeds and100 paired test scenarios, reduce the common sample budget to10000 before any test outcomes. This tests bounded learning, not convergence. One CPU thread/job, one training job, no new paid compute.

selection_provenance.interaction_candidate: not selected; Stage06 component fitting gives no policy-validation benefit
selection_provenance.finite_shot_candidate: not selected; Stage07 is frozen sensitivity only

execution_order_reason: Interleave methods within each paired seed; one training job at a time.
